page.layout: One page of text. A printed title block at the top, then a paragraph beginning with a woodcut initial, with running text below it. No margin notes. No running head, page number or signature is visible.
page.notes: The scan is heavily damaged. Most of the text is mirrored show-through from the reverse side, or is too faint to read. The title block at the top and the lines below the woodcut initial could not be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible and not guessed. The woodcut initial, which is a large decorated letter, is at the left centre of the text block. Only a few isolated words could be made out, and I have not written them down because they are uncertain. The line count and the paragraph breaks are approximate.
